title: A Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Neural Networks
text:
An introduction explaining the problem, concept, or task and why it matters

Neural networks are the foundation of deep learning and AI
A better understanding of how they work can inform your understanding on how AI and similar processes work

A tutorial body that explains the main ideas or steps

Basic structure of neural networks (neurons, input layers, hidden layers, output)
Loss functions/Gradient descent
Test/train validation

Examples that help readers understand or apply the idea

MNIST data set example
Apply each step of the above body to this data set

A conclusion and call to action that gives readers a concrete next step
